header.contentDescription: Dipole field lines as ribbons around a tilted magnetic axis, with the Earth turning beneath

drawTextAnchored.text: magnetic north sits about 11 degrees off it
two poles, like a bar magnet - but only roughly, and only for now
hundreds of times in the rock record, at no fixed interval
It is why there is air
the field turns the solar wind aside; Mars lost its field and then its atmosphere
a tilted dipole, turning with the planet
